title: 6kua Quality of Life
description:
這是一個為台灣伺服器文靜之潭開發的優化模組，目標是提升整體遊戲體驗。

This is an optimization mod developed for the Taiwanese server Wenjing zhi Tan with the goal of improving the overall gameplay experience.
body:
**6kua Quality of Life** 是一款專為**文靜之潭**伺服器打造的 Fabric 客戶端體驗優化模組。它的設計理念是在不修改伺服器資料、不取得不公平優勢的前提下,把 MMORPG 玩法中繁瑣的日常操作變得更直覺流暢。所有功能皆為純客戶端的顯示與輔助,玩家可於 /6kua 面板中逐項開啟或關閉。

## 自訂 HUD 系統
  模組提供一套完整、可視化的 HUD 編輯器,支援拖曳擺放、等比縮放、格線吸附與顏色 / 外框調整:
  - 技能 HUD — 在快捷列對應格顯示技能框、冷卻與剩餘秒數,並可在技能框上方顯示關聯 Buff 的剩餘時間。
  - Buff 追蹤面板 — 玩家可自行新增多個獨立面板,每個面板都能用白 / 黑名單(支援包含、完全相同、萬用字元 *)過濾要顯示的Buff,各自等比縮放。
  - DPS 統計 — 雙行顯示即時 DPS 與 10 秒平均 DPS,造成傷害時自動淡入、停手後淡出,也可切換為永久顯示。
  - 自訂圖片 / GIF 框 — 在 HUD 上永久顯示玩家指定的圖片或 GIF 動畫,適合放置個人標記或裝飾。

## 聊天強化
  - 滑鼠懸停聊天中的圖片 / GIF 連結即時預覽(最大 256×256,含 GIF 動畫播放),並自動修正 Discord CDN 連結格式。
  - 過長的圖片網址會自動壓縮為 [圖片] / [GIF] 標籤,保持聊天版面整潔,懸停即可預覽原圖。
  - 右鍵一鍵複製整條聊天訊息至剪貼簿,並有複製成功的視覺回饋。

## 介面與物品操作
  - Tooltip 滾輪捲動 — 長物品說明可用滾輪上下捲動,切換物品時自動歸零。
  - 物品複製 — CTRL+C 直接把整個 Tooltip 截圖複製為圖片;SHIFT+C 複製物品名稱與說明文字。
  - 對話選項快速選取 — 自動解析聊天中的對話選項,直接用數字鍵選擇,免去手動輸入指令。
  - 隨身背包整理 — 在「隨身背包」介面右上角提供整理 / 排序按鈕,自動將物品歸位排序。
  - 商店介面強化 — 將村民交易介面向左加寬為雙欄,支援左鍵選取、右鍵把常用交易置頂(金框並持久化保存)、左鍵雙擊快速交易。

## MMORPG 輔助
  - 衣櫥碼 / 技能組匯出 — 一鍵將目前裝備或技能配置編碼為分享字串,複製到剪貼簿,方便與他人交流配裝。
  - 世界標記與任務追蹤 — 在世界空間以方框 + 光柱標示重要座標,並自動為任務訊息建立計時標記;偵測到怪物生成時放置帶名稱的紅色標記並播放提示音。

## 其他
  - 全亮(Full Gamma) — 提升整體亮度、減少陰影,改善暗處可視性。
  - 多項細節皆可於設定面板自由開關,玩家可依個人需求取捨。

**6kua Quality of Life** is a Fabric client-side experience enhancement mod designed specifically for the **Wenjing zhi Tan** server. Its design philosophy is to make the repetitive daily operations of MMORPG gameplay more intuitive and fluid, without modifying server data or granting unfair advantages. All features are purely client-side visual and assistive tools, and players can enable or disable each function individually through the `/6kua` panel.

## Custom HUD System

The mod provides a complete visual HUD editor with support for drag-and-drop positioning, proportional scaling, grid snapping, and color / outline customization:

* Skill HUD — Displays skill frames, cooldowns, and remaining seconds on the corresponding hotbar slots. It can also show the remaining duration of related buffs above the skill frame.
* Buff Tracking Panels — Players can create multiple independent panels. Each panel can filter displayed buffs using a whitelist / blacklist system, supporting “contains,” “exact match,” and wildcard `*` matching. Each panel can also be scaled independently.
* DPS Statistics — Displays real-time DPS and 10-second average DPS in two lines. It automatically fades in when damage is dealt and fades out after the player stops attacking. It can also be switched to always display.
* Custom Image / GIF Frames — Permanently displays player-specified images or animated GIFs on the HUD, suitable for personal markers or decorative elements.

## Chat Enhancements

* Instantly previews image / GIF links in chat on mouse hover, with a maximum size of 256×256 and support for animated GIF playback. Discord CDN link formats are automatically corrected.
* Long image URLs are automatically compressed into `[Image]` / `[GIF]` tags to keep the chat layout clean. Hovering over the tag previews the original image.
* Right-click to copy an entire chat message to the clipboard, with visual feedback after successful copying.

## Interface and Item Operations

* Scrollable Tooltips — Long item descriptions can be scrolled up and down with the mouse wheel. The scroll position automatically resets when switching items.
* Item Copying — Press `CTRL+C` to copy the entire tooltip as an image screenshot; press `SHIFT+C` to copy the item name and description text.
* Quick Dialogue Option Selection — Automatically parses dialogue options in chat, allowing players to select options directly with number keys without manually entering commands.
* Portable Backpack Sorting — Adds organize / sort buttons to the upper-right corner of the “Portable Backpack” interface, automatically sorting items into the correct positions.
* Enhanced Shop Interface — Expands the villager trading interface to the left into a two-column layout. Supports left-click selection, right-click pinning of frequently used trades to the top with a gold frame and persistent saving, and double-left-click quick trading.

## MMORPG Assistance

* Wardrobe Code / Skill Build Export — Encodes the current equipment or skill configuration into a shareable string with one click and copies it to the clipboard, making it easier to share builds with others.
* World Markers and Quest Tracking — Marks important coordinates in the world with boxes and light beams, and automatically creates timed markers for quest messages. When monster spawns are detected, it places red name-labeled markers and plays an alert sound.

## Others

* Full Gamma — Increases overall brightness and reduces shadows, improving visibility in dark areas.
* Multiple detailed features can be freely enabled or disabled in the settings panel, allowing players to customize the mod according to their personal needs.
